title: Mahavira ne 12 saal bhookha reh kar kheer kyun khayi?
hooks: 12 saal bhookha raha Mahavira ne kyun?
Ek kheer ne badal di Mahavira ki tapasya
Kyun toda 12 saal ka vrat sirf kheer se?
hook_why: Direct question with shocking timeframe creates immediate curiosity; matches Jain audience's reverence for Mahavira's austerities
metaphor: Burning karmic layers like fire purifies gold — each year of fast burns one layer, kheer is the first pure offering received after complete purification

claims.claim: Mahavira practiced severe austerities for 12.5 years
claims.basis: Kalpasutra, traditional Jain texts; Wikipedia Mahavira entry confirms 12.5 years of intense meditation and austerities before Kevala Jnana

claims.claim: He broke his fast with kheer offered by a merchant (seth)
claims.basis: Kalpasutra narrative tradition; standard Jain hagiography episode of Mahavira's first alms (parana) after omniscience

claims.claim: The fast was for karmic purification (nirjara)
claims.basis: Jain doctrine: tapasya burns karmic particles; Kalpasutra describes Mahavira's austerities as karmic shedding

claims.claim: Kevala Jnana (omniscience) arose after this period
claims.basis: Kalpasutra, Acharanga Sutra; all Jain traditions agree Mahavira attained omniscience after 12.5 years of tapasya
